units.en: We seek to strengthen comprehensive security across all energy sectors and technologies and jointly address energy security challenges, ensuring uninterrupted, reliable, and affordable access to energy to enable economic prosperity. We encourage strengthened energy security through cooperation on supply chain resilience, secure cross-border infrastructure interconnection, and risk assessment. We recognize the benefits of timely restoration of critical energy infrastructure such as power plants, electric grids, submarine power cables and pipelines, and encourage sharing of economies’ experiences on market mechanisms, emergency preparedness and response, and strategic reserve management. We recognize the importance of secure and uninterrupted energy flows and cooperation across the whole supply chain including between producers and consumers in a mutually beneficial manner as well as fostering energy cooperation in the region. We will promote universal access to high-quality energy that is secure, reliable, abundant, resilient, and affordable, including for remote and rural areas. We encourage deepening voluntary cooperation on mutual enhancement between digital and emerging technologies and energy by supporting reliable, resilient and affordable energy for digital and emerging technologies development while harnessing digital and emerging technologies to enhance energy systems that deliver benefits for all. We recognize that conventional and zero and low emission energy sources and technologies provide a foundation for energy security, and strong and sustainable economic growth, and that each economy will choose an energy system mix consistent with its domestic priorities.

units.zh: 我们将努力促进开放、公平、透明、高产出、有韧性和创新的农业粮食体系，以惠及全民。我们将加强粮食安全政策伙伴关系，提高农业生产力和效率，通过创新和数字化增强区域粮食体系韧性，促进农业粮食体系转型，促进食品安全，改善全民营养，防止和减少粮食损失与浪费。我们支持基于科学和证据、由技术赋能的农业，包括用好数字和新兴技术等工具，并推进农业生物技术发展。我们重申致力于为农村地区拓展经济机遇。
units.en: We will work towards promoting open, fair, transparent, productive, resilient, and innovative agri-food systems that benefit all. We will strengthen policy partnership on food security, boost agricultural productivity and efficiency, enhance the resilience of regional food systems and supply chains, including through innovation and digitalization, promote the transformation of agri-food systems, advance food safety and nutrition for all, and prevent and reduce food loss and waste. We support science- and evidence-based, technology-enabled agriculture, including utilizing tools such as digital and emerging technologies and the advancement in agricultural biotechnology. We reaffirm our commitment to strengthening economic opportunities in rural areas.

units.zh: 我们认识到，森林为经济增长、生物多样性保护以及亚太地区的社区韧性和繁荣提供多重价值和贡献。我们支持合作打击非法采伐及相关贸易，促进合法采伐的林产品、可持续森林管理，制止并扭转森林丧失与退化。我们还将协作提升海洋和沿海社区的韧性，促进海洋资源的保护和管理，包括通过基于科学和技术的方式，打击非法、不报告和不受管制的捕捞，应对日益严峻的海洋垃圾挑战。
units.en: We recognize the multiple values and contributions that forests provide for economic growth, biodiversity conservation, and the resilience and prosperity of communities across the Asia-Pacific region. We support cooperation on combating illegal logging and associated trade while promoting legally harvested forest products, sustainable forest management, and halting and reversing forest loss and degradation. We will also collaborate to improve the resilience of marine and coastal communities and promote the conservation and management of ocean resources, including by combating illegal, unreported and unregulated (IUU) fishing and addressing the growing challenge of marine debris, while leveraging science- and technology-based approaches.

units.zh: 我们致力于打造有利的营商环境，支持中小微企业和初创企业抓住机遇，增强竞争力和创新性，实现增长。我们将支持中小微企业更好地获得资本、资产、技能培训和数字工具，支持中小微企业参与区域和全球价值链，并鼓励各经济体继续为中小微企业能力建设提供支持。我们鼓励开发可及、易用且具有成本效益的产品和解决方案，帮助中小微企业提高生产力和效率、扩大市场参与、加速数字化转型，并推动经济主体从非正规经济向正规经济和全球经济转型。
units.en: We are committed to fostering an enabling business environment that supports the growth of MSMEs and startups through opportunities to become more competitive and innovative. We will promote greater access for MSMEs to capital, assets, skills training and digital tools, support MSMEs’ participation in value chains, and encourage economies to continue providing support for MSMEs capacity building. We encourage the development of accessible, easy-to-use and cost-effective products and solutions that help MSMEs boost productivity and efficiency, expand market participation, accelerate digital transformation and facilitate the transition of economic actors from the informal to the formal and global economies.

units.zh: 我们认识到腐败的破坏性影响，它威胁经济增长、侵蚀公众信任、损害贸易和公平竞争，使资源偏离关键领域，为有组织犯罪等非法行为创造条件。我们决心通过有效的反腐倡廉措施促进增长与繁荣，继续共同努力反腐，包括打击跨境腐败，不为腐败分子和通过腐败及非法资产牟利者提供避风港，并就资产追回和返还加强合作。
units.en: We recognize the detrimental impact of corruption as a threat to economic growth, eroding public trust, harming trade and fair competition, diverting resources away from vital areas, and facilitating crimes, including organized crime. We resolve to promote growth and prosperity through effective anti-corruption and integrity measures, and continue our joint efforts to fight against corruption, including cross-border corruption, deny safe haven to corruption offenders including people who benefit from corruption and illicit assets, and strengthen cooperation on asset recovery and return.

units.zh: 作为我们共同努力深化亚太地区各领域合作的一部分，我们注意到2026年举行了妇女与经济、贸易、旅游、数字与人工智能、林业、粮食安全、中小企业、能源、运输、人力资源开发、财政等专业部长会议，以及数字周系列活动等其他高级别活动。我们赞赏亚太经合组织第37届外交和贸易双部长会议的成果，包括批准《奥特奥罗亚行动计划》五年审议，这些成果将作为未来合作的重要基础。
units.en: As part of our collective endeavors to deepen regional cooperation across all fronts, we note the convening of the 2026 sectoral ministerial meetings for Women and the Economy, Trade, Tourism, Digital and AI, Forestry, Food Security, Small and Medium Enterprises, Energy, Transportation, Human Resources Development, Finance, as well as other high-level events including during the Digital Weeks. We commend the outcomes of the 37th APEC Ministerial Meeting as an important basis for future cooperation, including the adoption of the five-year review of the Aotearoa Plan of Action.

units.zh: 工商界和其他利益相关方给亚太经合组织带来创造力、活力和能量，始终是我们的重要伙伴。我们期待与包括亚太经合组织工商咨询理事会和太平洋经济合作理事会在内的广大利益相关方进一步加强交流合作。
units.en: Our business communities and other stakeholders bring creativity, dynamism, and energy to APEC and remain vital partners in our work. We look forward to further strengthening multi-stakeholder engagement, as appropriate, including with the APEC Business Advisory Council (ABAC) and Pacific Economic Cooperation Council (PECC).

units.zh: 我们衷心感谢今年东道主中华人民共和国，感谢广东省深圳市的周到安排以及市民的热情好客。我们欢迎越南（2027年）、墨西哥（2028年）、新加坡（2030年）、日本（2031年）、智利（2032年）、巴布亚新几内亚（2033年）以及秘鲁（2034年）担任未来几年亚太经合组织东道主。
units.en: We extend our sincere gratitude to the People’s Republic of China and the people and city of Shenzhen, Guangdong Province for their warm hospitality and thorough arrangements. We look forward to the upcoming APEC host years of Viet Nam (2027), Mexico (2028), Singapore (2030), Japan (2031), Chile (2032), Papua New Guinea (2033), and Peru (2034).

files.name: 20261119 中俄美元首和平宣言 中英对照

units.zh: 中俄美元首和平宣言
units.en: China-Russia-U.S. Heads of State Declaration toward Peace

units.zh: 中国国家主席习近平、俄罗斯总统普京、美国总统特朗普于2026年11月19日在深圳举行会晤。俄美领导人感谢中方主办此次历史性会晤。三国元首就当前国际形势深入交换了意见，致力于维护战略稳定和国际安全。
units.en: Xi Jinping, President of the People's Republic of China, Vladimir Putin, President of the Russian Federation, and Donald J. Trump, President of the United States of America, met in Shenzhen on November 19, 2026. The Russian and U.S. heads of state expressed appreciation to China for hosting this historic trilateral Summit. The three heads of state had an in-depth exchange of views on the current international situation and committed to maintaining strategic stability and international security.

units.zh: 中国、俄罗斯、美国作为联合国安理会常任理事国，致力于推动联合国改革，使之更有效应对全球性挑战，并履行其维护国际和平与安全的基本使命。
units.en: 1. As permanent members of the United Nations Security Council, China, Russia, and the United States committed to reform the U.N. so that the U.N. can respond more effectively to global challenges and conform to its fundamental mission of international peace and security.

units.zh: 三国计划增加精炼石油产品的生产和供应，以造福世界各国。三国重申能源稳定流动的重要性。
units.en: 2. The three countries plan to increase the production and supply of refined petroleum products for the benefit of all nations. They reaffirmed the importance of stable energy flows.

units.zh: 三国元首认可国家同意原则和尊重国家官员享有豁免至关重要，一致认为国际刑事法院以及其他类似机构不得滥用管辖权。
units.en: 3. The three heads of state recognized that the principle of state consent and respect for immunities of State officials are of paramount importance, and concurred that the International Criminal Court and other similar bodies must not abuse their jurisdiction.

units.zh: 三国元首重申核战争打不赢也打不得。三国将就减少核风险、防止核扩散进行对话。
units.en: 4. The three heads of state reaffirmed that a nuclear war cannot be won and must never be fought. The three countries will conduct a dialogue on reducing nuclear risks and preventing the proliferation of nuclear weapons.

files.name: 20261119习近平在亚太经合组织第三十三次领导人非正式会议上的讲话 中英对照

units.zh: 建设亚太共同体，续写“亚太奇迹”新篇章 ——在亚太经合组织第三十三次领导人非正式会议上的讲话 （2026年11月19日，深圳） 中华人民共和国主席 习近平
units.en: Building an Asia-Pacific Community and Writing a New Chapter of the Asia-Pacific Miracle Remarks by H.E. Xi Jinping President of the People’s Republic of China At the 33rd APEC Economic Leaders’ Meeting Shenzhen, November 19, 2026

units.zh: 各位同事：
units.en: Dear Colleagues,

units.zh: 很高兴同大家相聚在美丽的深圳，共谋亚太合作大计。
units.en: I am delighted to welcome you to the beautiful city of Shenzhen to discuss the future of Asia-Pacific cooperation.

units.zh: 30多年前，亚太经合组织应运而生，开启了建设亚太共同体的壮阔历程。30多年来，亚太地区面貌日新月异，创造了经济快速发展的“亚太奇迹”。
units.en: The launch of APEC more than 30 years ago started a remarkable journey toward building an Asia-Pacific community. Over three decades and more, our region has witnessed progress with each passing day, and created the Asia-Pacific miracle of rapid economic growth.

units.zh: 当前，世界百年变局加速演进，科技创新和产业创新方兴未艾。面对新的机遇和挑战，亚太合作必须适应新形势、迈出新步伐、开创新局面，推动建设和衷共济、开放融通、开拓创新、包容发展的亚太共同体。
units.en: Today, momentous changes not seen in a century are accelerating across the globe. Innovation is burgeoning across sciences, technologies and industries. In the face of new opportunities and challenges, we must adapt to the new realities, take new strides, and open up new prospects for Asia-Pacific cooperation. Together, we must strive to build an Asia-Pacific community characterized by solidarity and mutual assistance, openness and integration, enterprise and innovation, as well as inclusive development.

units.zh: ——建设亚太共同体，要坚持和衷共济。浩瀚的太平洋承载千帆、滋养万物，造就了亚太地区兼收并蓄、和合共生的磅礴气象。亚太大家庭的成员同在一条船上，要经受住太平洋的风浪，就应当勠力同心、守望相助，拉紧共同利益纽带，携手应对困难和挑战，持续培育共同体意识。
units.en: —Building an Asia-Pacific community requires solidarity and mutual assistance. The vast Pacific Ocean, which carries thousands of ships and nurtures all life, has shaped the all-embracing character of the Asia-Pacific region—one defined by inclusiveness and harmonious coexistence. Members of APEC are like passengers riding the same ship. To navigate the waves of the Pacific, we must unite as one and look out for each other. We must expand our shared interests, meet the difficulties and challenges together, and steadily build a shared sense of community.

units.zh: ——建设亚太共同体，要坚持开放融通。开放合作是亚太发展振兴的必由之路。要秉持开放的区域主义，稳步推进经济一体化进程，构建开放而不排他、融合而不分割的合作格局。倡导自由开放的贸易和投资，打通要素流动堵点，畅通经济循环经脉，为亚太经济增长开拓更广阔空间。
units.en: —Building an Asia-Pacific community requires openness and integration. Open cooperation is a sure path to the development and revitalization of the Asia-Pacific. We should uphold open regionalism, steadily advance economic integration and develop a cooperation pattern that is open and integrated, rather than exclusive or fragmented. We should champion free and open trade and investment, remove impediments to the flow of factors, ensure the smooth circulation of economic lifeblood, and open up more space for economic growth in the Asia-Pacific.

units.zh: ——建设亚太共同体，要坚持开拓创新。创新是引领发展的第一动力。要鼓励科技交流合作，促进创新成果转化，营造开放、公平、公正、非歧视的合作环境。发扬进取精神，放大亚太经合组织孵化器作用，推动机制理念创新和结构性改革，不断释放亚太经济的活力和潜力。
units.en: —Building an Asia-Pacific community requires enterprise and innovation. Innovation is the primary driving force of development. It is vital to encourage scientific and technological exchanges and cooperation, facilitate the commercialization of innovation outcomes, and foster an open, fair, just and nondiscriminatory environment for cooperation. We need to carry forward our enterprising spirit, enhance APEC’s role as an incubator to encourage innovation in institutions and ideas as well as structural reform, and further unleash the economic dynamism and potential of our region.

units.zh: ——建设亚太共同体，要坚持包容发展。亚太经济体多样性突出，发展诉求各异。要因势利导推进合作，让发展成果普惠共享，增加民众获得感，照顾各方舒适度，为实现亚太共同体目标积累有利条件。
units.en: —Building an Asia-Pacific community requires inclusive development. Each with different development needs, Asia-Pacific economies are known for our diversity. We should advance cooperation where conditions allow, make sure development benefits everyone, deliver for the people, accommodate the comfort level of all parties, and foster favorable conditions for turning the vision of an Asia-Pacific community into reality.

units.zh: 各位同事！
units.en: Dear Colleagues,

units.zh: 中国是亚太经济合作的倡导者、推动者、先行者。中方愿同各方一道，集思广益、汇聚合力，携手搭建亚太共同体的“四梁八柱”。
units.en: China is an advocate, promoter and forerunner of Asia-Pacific economic cooperation. We would like to work with all parties to pool wisdom and synergy in building the four key pillars of an Asia-Pacific community.

units.zh: 强化经贸支柱。亚太自由贸易区是亚太经合组织成员的共同愿景，要稳步向前推进，打造更高水平的开放格局。要推动区域经贸协定对接，提升贸易投资便利化、数字化水平，减少贸易投资壁垒。围绕亚太自贸区加强政策对话，开展经验交流和技术合作，提高各方参与高水平经贸安排的能力。
units.en: First, we should strengthen the pillar of economy and trade. The Free Trade Area of the Asia-Pacific (FTAAP) is a shared vision of APEC members. It is important to make steady progress in realizing this vision and setting a higher standard for openness. Efforts should be made to align various regional economic and trade agreements, boost trade and investment facilitation and digitalization, and reduce barriers to trade and investment. It is also important to enhance policy dialogue on the FTAAP, and carry out experience sharing and technical cooperation, to help the parties build capacity for participating in high-standard economic and trade arrangements.

units.zh: 第二，升级联通支柱。互联互通是区域经济一体化的纽带。2014年，我们共同制定亚太经合组织互联互通蓝图。今天，区域互联互通迎来新的机遇。要巩固“硬联通”，完善基础设施网络，推动智慧海关、智慧交通建设。增强“软联通”，促进政策和监管协调，深化跨境支付合作，维护产业链供应链稳定畅通。密切“心联通”，便利商旅和人员往来，促进人文交流和民众相知相亲。
units.en: Second, we should upgrade the pillar of connectivity. Connectivity is a nexus of regional economic integration. In 2014, we jointly developed the APEC Connectivity Blueprint. Today, there are new opportunities for regional connectivity. We should strengthen physical connectivity by improving the infrastructure network, and developing smart customs and smart transportation. We should deepen institutional connectivity by harmonizing policies and regulations, deepening cooperation on cross-border payment, and keeping industrial and supply chains stable and unimpeded. We should also enhance people-to-people connectivity by facilitating travel for business, tourism and other purposes, and promoting cultural exchanges for better mutual understanding and closer ties among our peoples.

units.zh: 第三，打造创新支柱。数字经济和人工智能是创新增长的引擎。要加强数字基础设施建设，完善区域数据治理和协同合作，实现高效、便捷、安全的跨境数据流动。打造开放创新生态，促进人工智能广泛应用，推动产业转型升级、向新发展。
units.en: Third, we should foster the pillar of innovation. The digital economy and artificial intelligence (AI) are the engines of innovation-driven growth. We should strengthen digital infrastructure development, improve data governance and collaboration in the region, and achieve efficient, convenient and secure cross-border data flow. We should build an open ecosystem for innovation, encourage the broad application of AI, and promote the innovation-driven transformation and upgrading of industries.

units.zh: 第四，夯实发展支柱。面对层出不穷的全球性挑战，要加强能力建设，推动区域能源和粮食安全合作，深化跨境腐败治理。推动资源、环境、人口协调发展，加大自然资源合理利用和保护，拓展绿色低碳合作，实现经济可持续增长。支持改善民生和投资于人，实施健康老龄化行动，促进就业和职业技能开发，支持妇女经济赋权和青年人才交流，释放亚太人才活力。
units.en: Fourth, we should enhance the pillar of development. To respond to constantly emerging global challenges, we should strengthen capacity building, promote regional cooperation on energy and food security, and deepen anti-corruption governance across borders. We should coordinate the development of resources, the environment and population, scale up the rational utilization and protection of natural resources, and expand green and low-carbon cooperation to achieve sustainable economic growth. We should support livelihood improvements and invest in the people, launch healthy aging programs, facilitate employment and the development of vocational skills, and support women’s economic empowerment and young talent exchanges to tap into the full potential of talent across the Asia-Pacific.

units.zh: 亚太是中国安身立命之所。中方将始终如一支持亚太合作。我宣布，中方将提供2000万美元，资助开展亚太经合组织务实合作。中方将在深圳设立亚太共同体研究中心，开展政策研究和交流，提供智力支撑。中方将立足亚太合作，在数字技术、数据跨境流动、清洁能源、中小企业发展等领域设立合作机构，助力亚太创新、绿色增长。
units.en: China is rooted in the Asia-Pacific and will continue to support Asia-Pacific cooperation. I hereby announce that China will provide US$20 million to support APEC’s practical cooperation. We will establish a Center for Asia-Pacific Community Studies in Shenzhen to conduct policy research and exchanges and provide intellectual support. In line with the needs of Asia-Pacific cooperation, we will set up cooperation institutions in such areas as digital technology, cross-border data flow, clean energy, and the development of SMEs, to contribute to innovation-driven and green growth in the Asia-Pacific.

units.zh: 各位同事！
units.en: Dear Colleagues,

units.zh: 深圳又名“鹏城”。期待在我们共同努力下，亚太合作像大鹏一样展翅高飞、鹏程万里。
units.en: Shenzhen is known as the City of the Roc (named after a legendary bird of great size and strength). I hope that with our joint efforts, Asia-Pacific cooperation will spread its wings like the roc, and fly high and far to a bright future.

units.zh: 谢谢大家。
units.en: Thank you.

files.name: 20261118习近平在亚太经合组织第三十三次领导人非正式会议欢迎晚宴上的祝酒辞 中英对照

units.zh: 在亚太经合组织第三十三次领导人非正式会议欢迎晚宴上的祝酒辞 （2026年11月18日，深圳） 中华人民共和国主席 习近平
units.en: Toast Remarks by H.E. Xi Jinping President of the People’s Republic of China At the Welcome Dinner of The 33rd APEC Economic Leaders’ Meeting

units.zh: 各位同事， 各位来宾， 女士们，先生们，朋友们：
units.en: Dear Colleagues, Distinguished Guests, Ladies and Gentlemen, Dear Friends,

units.zh: 大家晚上好！
units.en: Good evening.

units.zh: 今晚，南海之滨灯火璀璨，鹏城深圳秋意盎然。在亚太经合组织第三十三次领导人非正式会议即将召开之际，我谨代表中国政府和中国人民，对各位嘉宾的到来表示热烈欢迎。
units.en: Tonight, the shores of the South China Sea are ablaze with light, and Shenzhen is at its autumn best. On the eve of the 33rd APEC Economic Leaders’ Meeting, I wish to extend, on behalf of the Chinese government and the Chinese people, our warmest welcome to all distinguished guests.

units.zh: 我曾讲过，看千年的中国去西安，看五百年的中国去北京，看一百年的中国去上海。今天，我想对大家说，看五十年的中国就来深圳。
units.en: I have often said that to see over a few thousand years of China, go to Xi’an; to see 500 years of China, go to Beijing; to see 100 years of China, go to Shanghai. Tonight, let me add this: To see 50 years of China, come to Shenzhen.

units.zh: 深圳是一个有大故事的地方。1978年，我第一次到深圳，看到的还是一个小渔村。弹指间40多年过去了，如今这里高楼林立、车水马龙，变化之大可谓沧海桑田。
units.en: Shenzhen is a place with a big story to tell. When I first set foot here in 1978, it was little more than a fishing village. In the blink of an eye, more than four decades have passed. Today, high-rises stretch across the horizon and traffic surges through the streets—a transformation nothing short of miraculous.

units.zh: 开放是深圳与生俱来的基因。从边陲小镇到国际化大都市，从引进外资和技术到积极参与制定国际规则，今天的深圳，贸易联通四海，商旅络绎不绝，成为中国高水平对外开放的窗口。
units.en: Openness is in Shenzhen’s DNA. From a remote border town to an international metropolis, from merely attracting foreign capital and technology to actively helping shape international rules—Shenzhen today has trade links spanning the globe and welcomes an endless stream of businesspeople and travelers. It stands as a window on China’s high-standard opening up.

units.zh: 创新是深圳的活力所在。从出口加工到自主研发，从“世界工厂”到创新之城，今天的深圳，每年国际专利申请量近2万件，先进制造业和现代服务业比翼齐飞，成为中国集群式创新的前沿。
units.en: Innovation is the wellspring of Shenzhen’s vitality. From export processing to independent research and development, from “world factory” to “city of innovation”—Shenzhen today files up to 20,000 international patent applications a year. Advanced manufacturing and modern services flourish side by side, placing the city at the forefront of China’s cluster-based innovation.

units.zh: 合作是深圳的力量之源。“来了就是深圳人。”这座城市以宽广胸怀接纳四面八方的奋斗者，汇聚来自100多个国家和地区的国际化人才，成为中国同各方合作共赢的热土。
units.en: Cooperation is the source of Shenzhen’s strength. As the people of Shenzhen like to say, “Once here, Shenzhener forever.” The city opens its minds and arms to go-getters from around the world and brings together talent from over 100 countries and regions, making it a vibrant hub of win-win cooperation between China and the rest of the world.

units.zh: 深圳的故事是中国改革开放的缩影。一代代建设者在改革开放中破冰突围、接续奋斗，解放和发展生产力，展现了中国式现代化的万千气象。
units.en: The Shenzhen story is a microcosm of China’s reform and opening up. Generation after generation of builders have started from scratch and worked tirelessly to blaze new trails. They have forged ahead in reform and opening up, unleashed and developed the productive forces, and showcased the great dynamism of Chinese modernization.

units.zh: 深圳的故事也是亚太合作的成功范例。亚太经济体突破地理限制和观念差异，积极投入区域合作的大舞台，创造了经济快速发展的“亚太奇迹”。
units.en: The Shenzhen story is also a shining example of Asia-Pacific cooperation. Economies across the region have risen above geographic constraints and differences in thinking, thrown themselves into the wide arena of regional cooperation, and created the Asia-Pacific miracle of rapid economic growth.

units.zh: 女士们、先生们、朋友们！
units.en: Ladies and Gentlemen, Dear Friends,

units.zh: 亚太经合组织成立以来，开放、创新、合作一直是其鲜明标识。从西雅图的初次握手到雁栖湖的历史盛会，从茂物目标的庄严承诺到亚太共同体的宏伟愿景，亚太经合组织始终把握时代脉搏、引领亚太经济一体化进程，助力亚太成为全球经济最具活力的地区和重要增长引擎。
units.en: Since its founding, APEC has always been known for openness, innovation and cooperation. From the first handshake in Seattle to the historic gathering by Beijing’s Yanqi Lake, from the solemn commitment to the Bogor Goals to the broad vision of building an Asia-Pacific community—APEC has remained attuned to the pulse of our times, spearheaded economic integration in the Asia-Pacific, and helped make this region the most dynamic in the global economy and a vital engine of world growth.

units.zh: 于道各努力，千里自同风。为了建设亚太共同体，我们跨越山海走到一起。中方担任今年亚太经合组织东道主以来，在16座城市举办了300多场会议和活动，各成员经济体代表逾万人次踊跃参与，为“中国年”收获更多重要成果作出贡献。在明天的领导人会议上，我们将讨论扩大相互开放的举措，探索创新驱动增长的路径，拓展各领域务实合作的机遇，推动更多成果落地。我期待同大家共商亚太合作大计、共襄亚太发展大业。
units.en: “On separate sails, we give our best; even a thousand miles apart, the same wind connects our quest.” This verse captures perfectly why we have crossed mountains and seas to come together—united by the shared purpose of building an Asia-Pacific community. Since becoming the APEC Chair, China has hosted over 300 meetings and events across 16 cities in the course of the year, with more than 10,000 delegates from member economies taking part and helping to deliver significant outcomes during the APEC China Year. At tomorrow’s Leaders’ Meeting, we will discuss steps to expand mutual openness, explore pathways to innovation-driven growth, extend opportunities for result-oriented cooperation across various fields, and strive to deliver more tangible results on the ground. I look forward to discussing with you the great endeavor of Asia-Pacific cooperation and advancing our shared cause of Asia-Pacific development.

units.zh: 现在，我提议，让我们一起举杯， 为亚太地区的共同繁荣， 为这次领导人非正式会议圆满成功， 为各位嘉宾和家人的健康， 干杯！
units.en: Now, I would like to propose a toast. Let’s raise our glasses: To the shared prosperity of the Asia-Pacific; To the great success of the APEC Economic Leaders’ Meeting; and To the health of all distinguished guests and your families. Cheers!

files.name: 20261118习近平在亚太经合组织工商领导人峰会上的主旨演讲 中英对照

units.zh: 坚定信心，勇毅前行 共创亚太光明未来 ——在亚太经合组织工商领导人峰会上的主旨演讲 （2026年11月18日，深圳） 中华人民共和国主席 习近平
units.en: Forging Ahead with Resolve Toward a Bright Future for the Asia-Pacific Keynote Speech by President Xi Jinping at the APEC CEO Summit Shenzhen, November 18, 2026

units.zh: 各位嘉宾， 女士们，先生们，朋友们：
units.en: Distinguished Guests, Ladies and Gentlemen, Dear Friends,

units.zh: 大家好！欢迎亚太工商界的朋友们！很高兴同大家在深圳见面。
units.en: Good morning! I wish to extend my welcome to you all, leaders of business communities of the Asia-Pacific. I am so delighted to meet you here in Shenzhen.

units.zh: 南海之滨，风劲潮涌。40多年来，深圳在中国改革开放春潮中勇立潮头、奋发进取，实现了从边陲小镇到国际化大都市的历史性跨越，创造了世界发展史上的一个奇迹。深圳的成功，给人们许多启示。
units.en: Shenzhen, on the shores of the South China Sea, embraces the surging winds and waves of the ocean. Over the past 40 years and more, Shenzhen has been a pioneer in China’s pursuit of reform and opening up. It has achieved a historic transformation from a small border town into an international metropolis, creating a miracle in the history of global development. There is so much people can draw from Shenzhen’s success.

units.zh: 当前，国际形势变乱交织，世界经济增长动能不足，单边主义、保护主义甚嚣尘上。与此同时，全球贸易在逆势中保持增长，新兴技术加速突破，深刻影响世界发展格局。世界怎么了？亚太怎么办？开放还是封闭，合作还是分化，变革还是守旧？都是我们必须回答的时代课题。
units.en: Today, we find ourselves in a changing and turbulent world. Global growth lacks momentum, and unilateralism and protectionism are rampant. Still, global trade keeps growing against headwinds, and breakthroughs are being made in emerging technologies at a faster pace, exerting a profound impact on global development. What is going on with the world? What should we do in the Asia-Pacific? To open doors or close doors, work together or against each other, adapt to change or stick to old ways? These are hard questions of our times that we must answer.

units.zh: 凡益之道，与时偕行。亚太经合组织伴随经济全球化浪潮而生，推动亚太地区引领时代风气之先。今年，中国第三次担任亚太经合组织东道主。中方愿同各方一道，坚定信心、勇毅前行，携手建设亚太共同体，促进亚太共同繁荣。
units.en: As an ancient Chinese saying goes, all approaches should adapt to changing times to remain relevant. Born amid the waves of economic globalization, APEC has enabled the Asia-Pacific to steer the course of our times. This year, China is hosting APEC for the third time. We are ready to work with all other parties to forge ahead with resolve, jointly build an Asia-Pacific community, and bring prosperity for all in our region.

units.zh: ——促进亚太共同繁荣，要维护和平稳定大局。稳，才能安；安，才能兴。亚太经济保持稳中向好，成为全球经济增长的重要引擎，得益于长期稳定的地区环境。越是外部形势复杂，我们越要坚定维护战后国际秩序，推进平等有序的世界多极化、普惠包容的经济全球化；越要坚持通过对话协商解决分歧，通过团结协作应对挑战，为亚太地区长治久安筑牢根基。
units.en: —To bring prosperity for all in the Asia-Pacific, we should uphold peace and stability. There can be no prosperity without security, and no security without stability. Thanks to the stable environment in our region over the past decades, the Asia-Pacific has maintained steady economic progress and become an important engine driving global growth. The more complex the external conditions become, the more important it is for us to uphold the postwar international order, and promote an equality-based and orderly multipolar world and economic globalization that is inclusive and brings benefit to all. It is even more important for us to resolve differences through dialogue and consultation, and overcome challenges through solidarity and cooperation. This is the way to cement the foundation for sustaining peace and stability in the Asia-Pacific.

units.zh: ——促进亚太共同繁荣，要搭建开放合作桥梁。历史经验证明，开放带来进步，封闭必然落后。我们要坚定维护以世界贸易组织为核心、以规则为基础的多边贸易体制，支持自由开放的贸易和投资，维护全球产业链供应链稳定畅通。稳步推进亚太自由贸易区进程，搭建全方位互联互通网络，加强贸易数字化、跨境电商、智慧海关等合作，深化产业链供应链国际合作，为亚太经济一体化建设铺路架桥。
units.en: —To bring prosperity for all in the Asia-Pacific, we should build bridges of opening up and cooperation. History tells us that opening doors brings progress while closing doors leaves one behind. We should firmly safeguard the WTO-centered, rules-based multilateral trading system, support free and open trade and investment, and keep global industrial and supply chains stable and unimpeded. We should work steadily toward a Free Trade Area of the Asia-Pacific, build a multidimensional connectivity network, enhance cooperation in areas such as digital transformation of trade, cross-border e-commerce, and smart customs, and deepen international cooperation on industrial and supply chains. All this will pave the way for greater economic integration in the Asia-Pacific.

units.zh: ——促进亚太共同繁荣，要激发创新增长动力。创新是推动社会进步的重要力量。亚太经合组织成员在全球科技创新中锐意进取，独角兽企业、人工智能大模型蓬勃涌现，一大批创新成果赋能千行百业、走进千家万户。我们要积极构建科技创新伙伴关系，深化数字经济、人工智能合作，促进绿色低碳转型，不断将创新优势转化为增长动能，为亚太经济增长提供强劲动力。
units.en: —To bring prosperity for all in the Asia-Pacific, we should boost innovation to drive growth. Innovation is crucial for progress. APEC members have driven global scientific and technological innovation: Unicorn companies and large AI models have emerged in large numbers, and many innovations have empowered hundreds of trades and industries and reached millions of households. We should forge science, technology and innovation partnerships, deepen cooperation in the digital economy and AI, and promote green and low-carbon transition. By doing so, we can turn strengths in innovation into drivers of growth, and provide strong impetus for economic growth in the Asia-Pacific.

units.zh: ——促进亚太共同繁荣，要拓展互利共赢路径。亚太各经济体历史文化和发展阶段不尽相同，推进合作不能搞整齐划一。要既消除贸易和投资壁垒，建设开放型亚太经济，又推动普惠均衡发展，兼顾效率和公平。要坚持以人民为中心的发展理念，面向发展中经济体加强经济技术合作，深化交通运输、公共卫生、能源、粮食安全、反腐败等合作，让发展成果惠及各经济体和不同的阶层及人群。
units.en: —To bring prosperity for all in the Asia-Pacific, we should expand our ways for mutual benefits and win-win outcomes. As the economies in our region differ in history, culture and stage of development, taking a uniform approach will not advance cooperation. We should remove trade and investment barriers to build an open Asia-Pacific economy. At the same time, we should promote development that is balanced and delivers benefits to all to ensure both efficiency and fairness. We should follow a people-centered development philosophy, strengthen economic and technical cooperation geared for developing economies, and deepen cooperation in transportation, public health, energy, food security, anti-corruption and other fields, so that development fruits are shared by all economies and all groups and communities.

units.zh: 亚太地区汇集了世界上最重要的湾区，湾区经济具有鲜明的开放性、协同性、外溢性。我们所在的深圳就位于粤港澳大湾区。中方支持成立世界湾区经济合作联盟，深化各湾区交流互动，探索亚太经济合作新路径。
units.en: The Asia-Pacific region is home to the world’s most important bay areas notable for their open and interconnected economies with positive spillover effects. Shenzhen, where we are now meeting, is part of the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area. China supports the establishment of a World Association for Bay Areas Economic Cooperation to deepen exchanges and interactions among bay areas from across the world. This will help us explore new ways for stronger economic cooperation in the Asia-Pacific.

units.zh: 各位嘉宾、各位朋友！
units.en: Distinguished Guests, Dear Friends,

units.zh: 今年是中国“十五五”开局之年。当前，中国经济保持向新向优向好发展态势，展现出强大韧性和活力。前三季度，中国经济增速达到4.6%，新质生产力加速发展，新发展格局加快构建，绿色低碳转型蹄疾步稳，“十五五”开局良好。中国“十五五”规划既是自身的发展蓝图，也为亚太乃至全球经济增长提供机遇清单，是中国面向全球工商界发出的合作邀约。
units.en: This year marks the start of China’s 15th Five-Year Plan for economic and social development. China’s economy maintains a strong momentum of high-quality, innovation-driven growth, demonstrating great resilience and vitality. In the first three quarters, the Chinese economy grew by 4.6 percent. New quality productive forces are developing more quickly, the new development pattern is being fostered at a faster pace, and green and low-carbon transition is steadily picking up speed. The 15th Five-Year Plan has gotten off to a good start. A blueprint for China’s development, the 15th Five-Year Plan also provides a list of opportunities for promoting economic growth in the Asia-Pacific and the wider world. Indeed, it is an invitation for cooperation China has sent to business communities from around the world.

units.zh: ——中国将为全球工商界提供超大规模的开放市场。中国是全球第二大消费市场，拥有全球规模最大的中等收入群体，投资和消费潜力巨大。从新能源汽车到智能家居，从银发经济到冰雪旅游，每一个新赛道都为全球企业带来新机遇。中国正在加快建设开放大市场，扩大优质产品和服务进口，将不断催生多样化新需求。几天前，第九届中国国际进口博览会在上海举办，在座很多工商界朋友都前往参加，发现了新的合作机遇。中国还将继续举办“出口中国”等系列活动，搭建各国优质商品进入中国市场的高效通道。
units.en: —China will provide global business communities with a super-sized open market. China is the world’s second largest consumer market. It has the largest middle income group in the world and enormous potential for investment and consumption. From new energy vehicles to smart homes, from the silver economy to ice and snow tourism, every new growth area is creating new opportunities for businesses across the world. As China accelerates the development of a big, open market and increases import of quality products and services, more diverse demands will be unleashed. Recently, the ninth China International Import Expo was held in Shanghai. Many of you present today attended the Expo and found new cooperation opportunities. China will also continue to host “Export to China” series and other events to open efficient channels to help quality products from across the world enter the Chinese market.

units.zh: ——中国将为全球工商界提供前景广阔的发展空间。创新驱动、绿色转型是中国经济的关键词。从机器人“进场打工”，到机器狗“下乡务农”，再到自动驾驶和无人机外卖，中国超大规模创新试验场让前沿技术在真实场景中接受检验、迭代打磨，不断转化为高质量发展活力。中国将加快构建现代化产业体系，推动科技创新和产业创新深度融合，支持传统产业转型升级、新兴产业发展壮大、未来产业前瞻布局，为全球企业技术创新和发展壮大提供强劲动能。
units.en: —China will provide global business communities with a promising land for development. Innovation-driven growth and green transition are the key words in observing China’s economy. From factory and farm robots, to autonomous driving and drone delivery, China is a super-sized innovation testing ground where frontier technologies are tested, improved and upgraded in real-world scenarios, and are then turned into high-quality growth drivers. China will step up efforts to build a modernized industrial system, and deepen integration between technological and industrial innovation. It will support the transformation and upgrading of traditional industries, the expansion of emerging industries, and the forward-looking planning of industries of the future. This will generate strong impetus for technological innovation and growth of businesses around the world.

units.zh: ——中国将为全球工商界提供互促共进的合作环境。2001年，中国首次举办亚太经合组织领导人非正式会议，同年加入世界贸易组织。25年来，中国全面履行“入世”承诺，在实现自身发展的同时同世界各国共享机遇、共促发展。面对单边主义、保护主义冲击，中国始终践行真正的多边主义，坚定维护多边贸易体制，维护世贸组织规则，推动世贸组织改革，不断为世界经济增长和国际经贸合作注入稳定性和确定性。无论国际风云如何变幻，中国同世界各国合作共赢的决心都不会改变。中方坚定不移推动共建“一带一路”高质量发展，欢迎亚太地区企业积极参与，共谋发展机遇、共享发展成果。中方将从降低关税、扩大准入，到探索规则、管理、标准等深水区改革，全面落实制造业准入又准营，稳步扩大服务业领域开放，为全球企业来华投资兴业提供更稳定、更可预期的优质环境。
units.en: —China will provide global business communities with an environment that enables mutually reinforcing cooperation. In 2001, China hosted the APEC Economic Leaders’ Meeting for the first time and joined the World Trade Organization in the same year. Over the past 25 years, China has fully honored its WTO accession commitments. While pursuing its own development, China has shared opportunities with other countries and worked for common development. China has stood up to unilateralism and protectionism, and remained committed to true multilateralism, to upholding the multilateral trading system and WTO rules, and to advancing WTO reform; it has steadily brought stability and predictability to world economic growth and international trade and economic cooperation. No matter how the international landscape may evolve, China will not waver in its pursuit of win-win cooperation with all other countries. China stays firmly committed to high-quality Belt and Road cooperation, and welcomes the active participation of businesses from across the Asia-Pacific so that we can create growth opportunities and share the fruits of development together. China will not only cut tariffs and expand market access but also go a step further—we will carry out reform in challenging areas, such as rules, regulation and standards, in order to fully ensure market access and an accommodating operating environment in the manufacturing sector, to steadily expand opening up in the service sector, and to foster a more stable and more predictable first-class environment for companies from around the world to invest and do business in China.

units.zh: 各位嘉宾、各位朋友！
units.en: Distinguished Guests, Dear Friends,

units.zh: 亚太是我们共同发展的天地，也是我们并肩合作的舞台。亚太工商界是全球经济的弄潮儿。希望大家发扬勇于创新、追求卓越的企业家精神，积极拓展商业合作机遇，为推进亚太经济一体化作出更大贡献。欢迎大家继续积极参与中国改革开放和现代化建设，共享中国式现代化机遇。
units.en: The Asia-Pacific is our home; it is here we jointly pursue development and cooperation. Asia-Pacific business communities are pioneers of the global economy. I hope you will carry forward the entrepreneurial spirit, boldly pursue innovation and excellence, explore and expand opportunities for business cooperation, and make greater contributions to economic integration in the Asia-Pacific. You are more than welcome to continue to get actively involved in China’s reform and opening up and modernization drive, and share in the opportunities created by Chinese modernization.

units.zh: 让我们携起手来，以开放纾发展之困，以创新聚增长之势，以合作谋共享之福，建设亚太共同体，共创亚太光明未来！
units.en: Let us join hands to meet challenges facing development through opening up, generate momentum for growth through innovation, and pursue prosperity for all through cooperation. Let us work together to build an Asia-Pacific community and deliver a bright future for our region.

units.zh: 谢谢大家。
units.en: Thank you.

files.name: 2026年11月17日外交部发言人郭嘉昆主持例行记者会

units.zh: 深圳卫视记者：亚太经合组织（APEC）领导人非正式会议即将在深圳举行。
units.en: Shenzhen TV: The APEC Economic Leaders’ Meeting is set to be held in Shenzhen.

units.zh: 深圳一直被视为中国改革开放的窗口。
units.en: Shenzhen has long been regarded as the window of China’s reform and opening up.

units.zh: 很多西方媒体的报道和社交平台上的Vlog视频都以“未来之城”“先进城市”等标签定义深圳。 这两天，深圳街头的机器人、机器狗和AI智能体吸引国内外宾客的关注。
units.en: Many western media coverage and vlogs on social media platforms portray Shenzhen as a “city of the future” and “an advanced city.” In recent days, robots, robotic dogs and AI agents on the streets of Shenzhen have drawn attention from guests at home and abroad.

units.zh: 发言人对此有何评论？
units.en: What is your comment on this?

units.zh: 郭嘉昆：我们也注意到，很多记者朋友在APEC新闻中心用上了AI智能眼镜和智慧演播室等科技帮手。
units.en: Guo Jiakun: We have noticed that many friends from the media are now using tech helpers such as AI smart glasses and smart studios in the APEC media center.

units.zh: 作为第三座主办APEC领导人非正式会议的中国城市，深圳成为中国高质量发展和高水平对外开放的靓丽名片之一，也见证了亚太区域经济一体化的发展。
units.en: As the third Chinese city hosting an APEC economic leaders’ meeting, Shenzhen has become a name card of China’s high-quality development and high-standard opening up, and witnessed the regional economic integration of the Asia Pacific.

units.zh: APEC领导人非正式会议即将拉开帷幕，中方期待同各方进一步凝聚共识，取得更多务实成果，为亚太乃至全球繁荣增长注入强劲动力。 凤凰卫视记者：16日，美国商务部发布《限制远程获取先进半导体》临时最终规则，以新加坡、泰国、马来西亚、印尼和巴西存在非法对华转运芯片高风险为由，要求向相关国家企业出口先进芯片时须申请美国出口许可证，从而防止受限制国家和企业获取美国敏感技术。
units.en: The 2026 APEC Economic Leaders’ Meeting will soon kick off. China looks forward to working with all sides to further build consensus and deliver more practical outcomes, so as to inject strong impetus into the prosperity and growth of the Asia Pacific region and the world at large. Phoenix TV: On November 16, the U.S. Commerce Department released an interim final rule titled “Addressing Remote Access to Advanced Semiconductors.” According to the rule, a license will be required to export advanced semiconductors to Singapore, Thailand, Malaysia, Indonesia, or Brazil—countries which present a higher-than-normal risk of diversion of chips to China. The aim is to prevent countries and companies subject to restrictions from gaining access to U.S. sensitive technologies. What’s your comment?

units.zh: 中方对此有何评论？ 郭嘉昆：美方不断泛化国家安全概念，滥用出口管制措施，甚至横加干涉中国同其他国家开展正常贸易与科技合作，无理打压中国高新技术产业发展。
units.en: Guo Jiakun: The move is yet another case of the U.S. overstretching the concept of national security, and abusing export control measures to interfere in normal trade and tech cooperation between China and other countries and go after China’s high-tech industry.

units.zh: 这是典型的经济胁迫和“长臂管辖”，背离双方达成的共识，损害中国企业正当权益，扰乱全球产供链稳定。
units.en: Such typical economic coercion and long-arm jurisdiction run counter to the common understandings between the two countries, harm the legitimate rights and interests of Chinese companies, and disrupt global supply chains.

units.zh: 中方将采取必要措施坚决维护自身正当权益。
units.en: China will do what is necessary to firmly safeguard its legitimate rights and interests.

units.zh: 韩联社记者：当地时间16日，美国总统特朗普表示，他可能会在中国与朝鲜国务委员会委员长金正恩会面，但目前尚不清楚金正恩委员长会否来华，称这取决于中方。
units.en: Yonhap News Agency: On November 16 local time, U.S. President Donald Trump said that he might meet with President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea (DPRK) Kim Jong Un in China, but that it was still unclear whether President Kim would come or not, adding that it was up to China.

units.zh: 中方对此有何评论？
units.en: What’s China’s comment on President Trump’s remarks?

units.zh: 朝鲜和美国是否有举行会谈的可能？
units.en: Is there any possibility that the DPRK and the United States will hold talks?

units.zh: （路透社亦问及）
units.en: (Similar Question from Reuters)

units.zh: 埃菲社记者：中方对包括西班牙、法国和德国在内的多国免签政策将于今年年底到期。
units.en: Guo Jiakun: We do not have information on that. EFE: The visa-free policy for countries including Spain, France and Germany expires at the end of this year.

units.zh: 中方是否会延长该政策？ 何时会发布相关公告？
units.en: Will China extend it, and when can we expect an announcement?

units.zh: 郭嘉昆：中方重视中外人员往来便利化，正在认真研究相关政策。
units.en: Guo Jiakun: China attaches high importance to facilitating people-to-people exchange with other countries and is assessing relevant policies.

units.zh: 法新社记者：美国政府正在调查新加坡公司超速国际（MegaSpeed）是否违反美国出口管制规定，帮助中国企业获取英伟达最先进的技术。
units.en: AFP: The U.S. government is investigating Singapore-based firm MegaSpeed for whether it helped shift NVIDIA’s most powerful technology to Chinese firms in violation of U.S. export restrictions.

units.zh: 中方对此有何评论？ 是否掌握中国境内有哪些企业曾通过该公司获得相关技术？
units.en: Does China have a comment on the investigation and is China aware of any firms within China that had obtained this technology from MegaSpeed?

units.zh: 郭嘉昆：刚才我已经回答了相关问题。
units.en: Guo Jiakun: I just answered a question relating to this subject.

units.zh: 中方在美国输华芯片问题上的立场是一贯的。
units.en: I need to stress that China’s position on U.S. chip exports to China is consistent.

files.name: 20261014李强在第140届中国进出口商品交易会开幕式上的主旨演讲 中英对照

units.zh: 在第140届中国进出口商品交易会开幕式上的主旨演讲 （2026年10月14日，广州） 中华人民共和国国务院总理 李强
units.en: Keynote Speech by H.E. Li Qiang Premier of the State Council of the People’s Republic of China At the Opening Ceremony of the 140th Session of China Import and Export Fair Guangzhou, October 14, 2026

units.zh: 尊敬的各位来宾， 女士们，先生们，朋友们：
units.en: Distinguished Guests, Ladies and Gentlemen, Friends,

units.zh: 很高兴同大家相聚在美丽的花城广州，共同出席第140届中国进出口商品交易会。我谨代表中国政府，对各位的到来表示热烈欢迎！对大家长期以来为促进中外经贸合作和发展所作出的积极贡献表示衷心感谢！
units.en: It is a great pleasure to join you in the beautiful Flower City Guangzhou for the 140th Session of China Import and Export Fair (Canton Fair). On behalf of the Chinese government, I would like to extend a warm welcome to you all, and express heartfelt appreciation for your long-standing, positive contribution to the economic and trade cooperation and development between China and other countries.

units.zh: 今年是广交会创办70周年。习近平主席专门发来贺信，充分肯定广交会取得的成绩，重申了中国扩大高水平开放的坚定决心。过去70年，广交会一步步发展壮大，展览面积从首届的9600平方米扩大到现在的155万平方米，采购商从最初的1200人增加到今年的30多万人，已经成为中国举办的历史最长、规模最大、成交最多的国际贸易盛会，同时也为国际社会了解中国提供了重要窗口。透过广交会这扇“窗”，世人看到了中国经济社会蕴藏的巨大活力，见证了中国亿万民众一路奋发进取的壮阔历程，更感受到中国和世界与日俱增的深厚联结。
units.en: This year marks the 70th anniversary of the Canton Fair. President Xi Jinping has sent a congratulatory letter to the Fair, acknowledging its past achievements and reaffirming China’s commitment to expanding high-standard opening up. Over the past 70 years, the Canton Fair has grown from strength to strength. Its exhibition area has expanded from 9,600 square meters in the first year to 1.55 million square meters today. The number of buyers has increased from 1,200 in the beginning to more than 300,000 this year. Among all the international trade exhibitions hosted by China, the Canton Fair has the longest history, the largest participation and the highest transaction volume. It is also an important window for the international community to observe China. Through this window, the world has witnessed the surging vitality of China’s economy and society, the enterprising journey undertaken by hundreds of millions of Chinese people, and the deepening connection between China and the world.

units.zh: 一是日益开放的中国为世界带来新机遇。70年来，广交会因开放而生、因开放而兴，国际“朋友圈”越来越大，采购商遍布220多个国家和地区，累计成交额达到1.6万亿美元。这背后，是中国以开放促发展的战略选择，也是各国经济优势互补、相互赋能的现实需要。中国已是160多个国家和地区的主要贸易伙伴，也是近80个国家和地区的第一大出口目的地，对外投资存量达到3.4万亿美元，既发展了自己，也造福了世界。
units.en: First, a China that keeps opening itself creates new opportunities for the world. Over the past 70 years, the Canton Fair has established itself and thrived on openness. Its circle of friends has grown bigger, with buyers coming from over 220 countries and regions, and the total value of business deals reaching US$1.6 trillion. What underlies this success is China’s strategic choice of boosting development through openness, and the practical need for countries around the world to leverage their economic strengths for mutual empowerment. China is now a key trading partner of over 160 countries and regions, and the top export destination for nearly 80 countries and regions. China’s stock of overseas investment has reached US$3.4 trillion. While developing itself, China has also brought benefits to the world.

units.zh: 二是持续创新的中国为世界提供新动能。70年来，广交会的展品不断焕新升级，从上世纪六七十年代的农副土特产品，到八九十年代的轻工机电产品，再到现在的具身智能、智慧医疗等，可以说日新月异。这背后，是中国坚持创新发展的快速进步，也是世界科技革命和产业变革的生动缩影。近年来，中国人工智能、绿色能源、生物医药等领域的新技术新产品新业态持续涌现，为世界经济增添新动力、打开新空间。
units.en: Second, a China that keeps innovating itself provides new impetus for the world. Over the past 70 years, exhibits at the Canton Fair have been continuously transformed and upgraded. From agricultural and subsidiary products and local specialties in the 1960s and 70s, to industrial and electromechanical products in the 1980s and 90s, and to embodied artificial intelligence (AI) and smart medical services today, each session of the Canton Fair presents an updated selection of exhibits. What underlies this transformation is China’s rapid progress in innovation-driven development, and the world’s scientific and technological revolution and industrial transformation. In recent years, new technologies, products and business forms in such areas as AI, green energy and biomedicine have continued to emerge in China, and generated new dynamism and space for the world economy.

units.zh: 三是重信守诺的中国为世界注入确定性。70年来，无论国际局势如何变化，广交会从未间断，对“重合同、守信用”的办会原则奉行不渝。这背后，是中国“言必信、行必果”的价值追求，也是国际社会对中国的认可信任。中国长期保持政策稳定性连续性，坚定履行降低关税水平、加强发展援助、应对气候变化等各方面承诺，在动荡变革的世界中展现出大国的责任担当。
units.en: Third, a China that always keeps its promise brings certainty to the world. Over the past 70 years, no matter how the international situation evolved, the Canton Fair has never been interrupted, and its commitment to the principle of honoring contracts and maintaining credibility remains steadfast. What underlies such commitment is the Chinese philosophy of matching words with actions, and the world’s recognition of and trust in China. China has all along kept its policies stable and consistent, firmly delivered on its commitment of lowering tariffs, increasing development assistance and addressing climate change, and undertaken the responsibilities of a major country in this turbulent and changing world.

units.zh: 纵观这70年，广交会之所以能够经受住国际风云变幻的考验，不断焕发新的生机活力，正是因为始终顺应经济全球化的大势、始终响应国际社会携手发展的期盼。这其中蕴含着一些朴素而深刻的启示，值得我们深入思考。这里我想分享三点体会，同大家交流。
units.en: Looking back on the past 70 years, the Canton Fair has stood the test of international vicissitudes and brimmed with new vigor and vitality. This is because it has all along followed the trend of economic globalization and answered the call of the international community for joint development. The journey of the Canton Fair offers some simple yet profound takeaways worthy of deep reflection. Here, I would like to share with you three main observations.

units.zh: 第一，市场联通不是国与国博弈工具，而是创造增量的有效举措。这些年，全球各类人为市场壁垒明显增多，有的甚至把经贸问题政治化、工具化、武器化，然而将这些外衣层层剥下，就会发现，保护主义总是深藏其中。理论和实践已经充分证明，市场从来就不是一成不变的，而更像一张四通八达的网络，只有连接更多新的网络，才能更好地形成规模经济、更高效地匹配供给需求，才能创造更多价值、开辟更大空间。保护主义看似能守住一国市场，却也切断了市场延伸拓展的可能，更会在新的全球市场网络中失去位置，最终是得不偿失。
units.en: First, market connectivity is not a tool for zero-sum games between countries, but an effective measure to foster new space for growth. The past few years have seen a notable rise in manmade market barriers of various sorts around the globe. Some have even chosen to politicize, instrumentalize, and weaponize economic and trade issues. However, no matter their forms, protectionism is always at the core. It has been fully proven by both theories and practices that the market is not static—it is more like a network that reaches out in all directions. Only when connected to more such networks, can a market achieve economy of scale, match supply with demand more efficiently, and create more value and space. Protectionism may seem effective for a country to sustain its market, but it also makes it impossible for the country to broaden its market. Worse still, it may even lose its place in the new global network of markets. At the end of the day, protectionism will only produce more losses than gains.

units.zh: 长期以来，中国致力于推动国内市场与国际市场不断融合、共同成长。我们的进口规模已经连续17年位居世界第二，去年超过18万亿元，今年前三季度又增长22.3%。中国开放了这么多年，市场不仅没有缩小，反而伴随引入各国的汽车、家电等新产品新产业，发掘培育了更多新的市场需求。同时，中国出口的优质产品特别是一些创新产品，也在持续推动全球市场拓展新的增量空间。中国愿同各国一道，继续构建开放型世界经济，加强彼此联通对接，把全球市场越做越大，让各方得到更多收益。
units.en: Throughout the years, China has been committed to integrating its domestic market with the international markets for joint growth. China has been the second largest importer in the world for 17 consecutive years, exceeding RMB 18 trillion yuan last year, and growing by another 22.3 percent in the first three quarters this year. Decades have passed since China opened itself to the world, yet its market has not contracted. Instead, the introduction of new products and industries from other countries, such as automobiles and home appliances, has unlocked and cultivated new market demands. Meanwhile, the export of quality Chinese products, especially innovative products, is opening up new space for the global marketplace. China is ready to work with all countries to build an open world economy and strengthen market connectivity so as to make the global market bigger and deliver greater benefits to all.

units.zh: 国际贸易不是账面数字，而是增进福祉的自主选择。近段时期，国际上对贸易平衡问题的讨论不少。经济规律表明，贸易平衡是短期的、相对的，不平衡是普遍的、动态的，这是各国比较优势、经济结构、产业分工等差异决定的。我们要看到，贸易的本质是互惠互利，不能简单认为顺差就是“占便宜”、逆差就是“吃亏了”。贸易平衡是在贸易各方各取所需、良性互动中自然趋近的，而不是靠筑墙设垒甚至打压遏制。如果一边搞出口管制，一边指望贸易平衡，这是不现实的，反而会推高成本、扰乱产供链，进一步加剧不平衡。我们需要的，是扩大开放、共同做大“蛋糕”的“向上平衡”，而不是封闭市场、必将导致萎缩的“向下平衡”。
units.en: Second, international trade is not just statistics in the books, but a voluntary choice aimed to improve people’s well-being. Recently, there have been quite some discussions about the issue of trade balance globally. The laws of economics tell us that a balanced position in trade is temporary and relative, while an imbalanced position is more common and non-static. This is determined by countries’ differences in comparative strengths, economic structures, distribution of labor, and other variables. We need to see that trade is mutually beneficial in nature. One cannot simply view surplus as “taking advantage” and deficit as “being ripped off.” A balanced trade would naturally arrive when the parties can satisfy their respective demands through positive interactions. It is not achieved by building walls, setting up barriers, or even suppressing and containing others. It is simply unrealistic to impose export control on others while looking for balanced trade at the same time. Such a practice will only push up costs, disrupt industrial and supply chains, and further aggravate the imbalance. What we need is “upward balance” achieved by opening up wider and making the economic pie bigger, not “downward balance” resulting from market closure and the inevitable market contraction that follows.

units.zh: 现在一些人谈及中国贸易，往往只看到进出口数字，而没有关注到背后的真实效应。中国既是“超级卖家”，也是“超级买家”。作为“超级卖家”，我们给各方带来的更多是“惠邻效应”。无数勤劳的中国劳动者用汗水智慧铸就的高性价比商品，大幅提升了全球消费者的实际购买力，提高了各国民众生活质量，增强了相关国家的产业发展能力。作为“超级买家”，我们给各方带来的更多是“富邻效应”。很多国家的农产品、工业品、消费品源源不断销往中国，转化为当地企业利润、居民工资和政府税收。中国从不刻意追求顺差，更何况现在很多时候是“顺差在中国，利益在各方”，大量在华外资企业产品出口全球、获得丰厚收益。我们愿意购买更多外国产品特别是高附加值产品，去年至今已累计举办约70场“共享大市场·出口中国”活动，下个月还将在上海举办第九届中国国际进口博览会。希望更多国家同我们相向而行、放开限制，积极推动贸易优化平衡发展。
units.en: Some current discussions about China’s trade focus on import and export statistics, but overlook the real effects behind them. China is both a “super seller” and a “super buyer.” As a “super seller,” China brings benefits to its trading partners. Quality, affordable goods made by diligent Chinese workers with their labor and wisdom have significantly increased the actual purchasing power of global consumers, improved their quality of life, and helped countries strengthen their capacity for industrial development. As a “super buyer,” China helps to boost the prosperity of other countries. China is a major buyer of agricultural, industrial, and consumer goods from many countries, which translate into profits for local businesses, income for the people, and revenues for the governments. China never seeks surplus intentionally, not to mention the fact that most of the times, the benefits are shared by all parties, despite the surplus being recorded in China. A large number of foreign-invested enterprises in China export their products across the world and secure big returns. We would like to buy more products from across the world, especially high value-added products. Since last year, we have hosted around 70 events themed “Big Market for All: Export to China.” Next month, we will host the ninth China International Import Expo in Shanghai. China hopes that more countries will work together in the same direction, lift restrictions, and pursue better, balanced development of trade.

units.zh: 互利共赢不是单向妥协，而是相互赋能的彼此成就。通往全球繁荣发展之路，零和博弈不可取，互利共赢才是正途。要实现真正的共赢，不能依靠简单的对价交换，更不能依靠强压下的妥协让步，而需要平等相待、双向奔赴、共同成长。当前国际产供链各环节彼此嵌套、紧密衔接，只要各国精诚协作、取长补短，就能实现更高水平、更可持续的共赢。在这其中，发达国家应当更加积极行动，给予发展中国家更多资金技术支持、经贸政策优惠，帮助他们提高产业水平、增强发展内生动力。
units.en: Third, win-win cooperation does not mean one-sided concession but mutual empowerment and success. On the path toward global prosperity and development, win-win cooperation is the only right choice. A zero-sum approach hurts everybody. For true win-win cooperation to happen, we cannot rely on a simple quid pro quo, still less compromise or concessions under pressure. What we need is to treat each other as equals, meet each other halfway, and make progress together. With all the links of global industrial and supply chains interlocked and closely connected, it is possible to realize more sustainable win-win cooperation at a higher level if countries work together in good faith and draw on each other’s strengths. In this process, developed countries should take more proactive actions, provide developing countries with more capital and technological support and preferential economic and trade policies to help boost their industries and strengthen the internal drivers of growth.

units.zh: 中国作为最大的发展中国家，始终致力于推动共同发展，在自身发展的同时，一直尽最大努力帮助和支持其他发展中国家。这些年，中国推动高质量共建“一带一路”，越来越多发展中国家，依托中国的产品、技术和资金，完善本国工业体系、提升高端出口能力，产业升级持续加快，在全球价值链中的位置不断攀升。中国在海外投资设立的企业已超5万家，近九成布局在全球南方国家，其中不少国家的制造业快速崛起，出口创汇大幅增长。中国将永远是发展中国家可信赖、可倚重的好朋友，愿在现代化的道路上帮助他们铺路架桥，与之携手相伴、坚定同行。
units.en: China, as the largest developing country, is committed to advancing common development. While developing itself, China has done its utmost to help and support other developing countries. Over the years, China has been advancing high-quality Belt and Road cooperation. More and more fellow developing countries, supported by China’s products, technology and capital, have improved their domestic industrial systems, raised high-end export capacity, kept accelerating industrial upgrade, and as a result, continued to move up the global value chain. There are over 50,000 overseas companies set up with Chinese investments, 90 percent of which are in Global South countries. Many of these countries have seen their manufacturing rapidly growing and foreign exchange earnings from exports rising significantly. China will always be a good friend that other developing countries can trust and rely on. China stands ready to help pave the way for other developing countries as they pursue modernization. We will join hands and move forward together with fellow developing countries.

units.zh: 多年来，中国一直是全球开放合作的积极践行者，坚持以自身所能为世界所需作出重要贡献。今年面对国际形势变乱交织，中国经济顶住压力稳健前行，展现出强大韧性和活力，我们有信心有能力完成全年经济社会发展目标任务。中国将持续推动高质量发展，扩大高水平开放，以积极务实行动，为世界经济增添更多动力。
units.en: Over the years, China has been actively carrying out global open cooperation and made important contribution to meeting the world’s needs with its utmost efforts. This year, confronted with global changes and turbulence, the Chinese economy has withstood pressure and forged ahead steadily, demonstrating robust resilience and vitality. We are confident and capable of accomplishing the goals and tasks for economic and social development this year. China will continue to advance high-quality development, expand high-standard opening up, and take more practical actions to inject more momentum into the world economy.

units.zh: 一是分享更多市场机遇。中国超大规模市场需求正在加快释放，去年社会消费品零售总额首次突破50万亿元，未来5年预计再增长约10万亿元。我们将坚定实施扩大内需战略，促进消费升级，同时进一步降低市场准入门槛，加强对企业的服务保障。欢迎更多外国企业来华投资兴业。
units.en: First, we will share more market opportunities. The demand of China’s supersized market is unleashing at a faster pace. Last year, total retail sales of consumer goods exceeded RMB 50 trillion yuan for the first time, and are expected to increase by about another RMB 10 trillion yuan in the next five years. We will firmly implement the strategy of expanding domestic demand and advance consumption upgrade, further lower the threshold of market access, and provide better services and safeguards for enterprises. We welcome more foreign companies to do business in China.

units.zh: 二是拓展更多互利合作。中国将坚持与世界同进步，深化与各国发展战略对接，支持有实力的中国企业有序赴海外投资，加强技术交流，拓展新兴领域合作，开展更多本土化经营，助力当地产业提质增效和经济发展。
units.en: Second, we will expand more mutually beneficial cooperation. China is committed to pursuing progress together with the world and deepening alignment of development strategies with other countries. We support capable Chinese companies in investing overseas in an orderly manner, strengthening technological exchanges, expanding cooperation in emerging sectors, and conducting more localized operations, to help upgrade local industries and boost local economy.

units.zh: 三是坚定维护国际经贸秩序。中国将始终站在历史正确的一边，坚定维护多边主义和自由贸易，支持世贸组织改革发展，与各方一道探索制定面向未来的国际经贸规则，不断改革完善全球经济治理，推进普惠包容的经济全球化。
units.en: Third, we will firmly uphold international economic and trade order. China will always stand on the right side of history, firmly uphold multilateralism and free trade, and support WTO reform and development. We will work with all parties to explore and make future-oriented international economic and trade rules, reform and improve global economic governance, and advance a universally beneficial and inclusive economic globalization.

units.zh: 70年春华秋实。相信广交会一定会常办常新、越办越好。祝愿大家在这里结识更多新朋友、达成更多新合作、收获更多新成果。让我们一道努力，共同开创更加美好的未来！ 谢谢大家！（完）
units.en: Seven decades of hard work have yielded fruitful results. I believe the Canton Fair will make new and even better progress going forward. I hope that you will make more friends here, carry out more cooperation, and reap more fruits. Let us work together to usher in a better future. Thank you.

files.name: 20260928韩正在第81届联大一般性辩论上的讲话 中英对照

units.zh: 韩正在第81届联大一般性辩论上的讲话
units.en: Statement by H.E. Han Zheng Vice President of the People’s Republic of China At the General Debate of the 81st Session of The United Nations General Assembly

units.zh: 顺应发展潮流 勇担历史使命
units.en: Riding the Waves of Development and Shouldering Our Historic Responsibilities
New York, September 26, 2026

units.zh: 中华人民共和国副主席 韩正 主席先生，各位同事：
units.en: Mr. President, Colleagues,

units.zh: 当前，国际形势变乱交织，地缘冲突延宕不止、发展鸿沟持续扩大、全球性挑战层出不穷。5年前，习近平主席在第76届联合国大会上提出全球发展倡议，之后又相继提出全球安全倡议、全球文明倡议、全球治理倡议，为构建人类命运共同体提供了战略指引。在各国前途命运紧密相连的今天，越来越多的国家愿携起手来，担当历史使命，应对困难挑战，增进人类共同福祉。为此，我愿提4点建议。
units.en: The world is witnessing intertwined changes and turbulence, protracted geopolitical conflicts, widening development gaps and a growing number of global challenges. Five years ago, at the 76th Session of the U.N. General Assembly, President Xi Jinping put forward the Global Development Initiative. Since then, he has proposed the Global Security Initiative, the Global Civilization Initiative and the Global Governance Initiative. These initiatives provide strategic guidance for the building of a community with a shared future for humanity. At a time when countries of the world find their future so closely linked, more and more of them want to join hands to shoulder the historic mission of addressing difficulties and challenges, and advancing the well-being of all humanity. With this in mind, I propose that we take the following four steps.

units.zh: 第一，维护战后国际秩序，以共同安全构筑持久和平。世界要和平、不要战争。二战后形成的以联合国为核心的国际体系和以国际法为基础的国际秩序，必须加以维护。要践行共同、综合、合作、可持续的安全观，摒弃冷战思维、阵营对抗，坚持通过对话协商化解分歧和争端，反对违反联合国宪章、绕开联合国安理会授权的单边军事行动。大国对国际和平和安全负有特殊责任，尤其要带头守规矩、讲法治、行正道。
units.en: First, we should safeguard the postwar international order and foster lasting peace based on common security. The world wants peace, not war. The international system centered on the U.N. and the international order underpinned by international law that emerged after World War II must be upheld. We should turn into action the vision of common, comprehensive, cooperative, and sustainable security, and reject the Cold War mindset and bloc confrontation. We should settle differences and disputes through dialogue and consultation, and oppose unilateral military actions that violate the U.N. Charter and circumvent Security Council authorization. Major countries shoulder special responsibilities for safeguarding international peace and security, and they should take the lead in complying with rules, upholding rule of law and doing what’s right.

units.zh: 中方认为，中东海湾国家的主权和安全都应当得到尊重，国际产业链供应链稳定畅通和贸易往来应当得到保障。中方呼吁秉持“巴人治巴”原则推进约旦河西岸治理和加沙战后重建，推动巴勒斯坦问题早日重回“两国方案”正确轨道。在乌克兰问题上，中方始终以习近平主席提出的“四个应该”为根本遵循，将继续以自己的方式为危机政治解决发挥建设性作用。中方敦促有关国家立即停止对古巴武力威胁，立即全面取消对古巴封锁制裁。
units.en: China holds that the sovereignty and security of countries in the Middle East including the Gulf should be respected, international industrial and supply chains should be kept stable and unimpeded, and global trade should be safeguarded. China calls for advancing the governance of the West Bank and the post-conflict reconstruction of Gaza in accordance with the principle of the Palestinians governing Palestine. It also calls for bringing the Palestinian question back onto the right track of the two-state solution at an early date. On Ukraine, President Xi Jinping has put forward four points on what must be done, which are the fundamental guidance for China in playing a continued, constructive role in its own way for achieving a political settlement of the crisis. China urges the relevant country to immediately stop using threat of force against Cuba and immediately and completely lift the blockade and sanctions against Cuba.

units.zh: 第二，直面全球发展困境，以开放合作促进共同繁荣。要始终将发展置于国际议程中心位置，共建团结、平等、均衡、普惠的全球发展伙伴关系。要聚焦减贫、粮食安全、能源转型等重点领域，进一步加大资源投入和对全球南方国家的支持。发达国家应切实兑现发展筹资和气候融资承诺。国际社会还应当为制定2030年后全球发展议程凝聚共识和力量。面对新一轮科技革命和产业变革特别是人工智能技术的蓬勃发展，要秉持以人为本、向上向善理念，努力缩小数字鸿沟，共促普惠发展。
units.en: Second, we should address the global development predicament and promote prosperity for all through openness and cooperation. We should keep development at the center of the international agenda, and jointly forge a global development partnership based on unity and equality and that is balanced and inclusive. It is important to give priority to key areas including poverty reduction, food security and energy transition, step up resource input, and increase support for countries in the Global South. Developed countries should honor their commitment to development financing and climate financing. The international community should also build consensus and pool strengths to formulate the post-2030 global development agenda. Facing a new scientific and technological revolution and industrial transformation, especially the dynamic development of artificial intelligence, we should take a people-centered approach and develop AI for the positive and for good, narrow the digital divide, and promote development that is universally beneficial.

units.zh: 历史和现实都证明，各国发展离不开开放合作的国际环境，保护主义没有赢家，搞“筑墙设垒”、“脱钩断链”扰乱全球产业链供应链稳定畅通，损害各方利益。要坚定维护以世界贸易组织为核心、以规则为基础的多边贸易体制，坚持建设开放型世界经济，共同培育壮大增长新动能，推动普惠包容的经济全球化。
units.en: Both history and reality prove that countries can hardly achieve development without an open and cooperative international environment. Protectionism produces no winners; building walls, erecting barriers, decoupling and cutting off supply chains disrupt global industrial and supply chains and harm the interests of all parties. We must firmly safeguard the WTO-centered, rules-based multilateral trading system, build an open world economy, jointly foster and strengthen new growth drivers, and see that economic globalization is inclusive and delivers benefits to all.

units.zh: 第三，促进文明交流互鉴，以沟通对话重建团结互信。世界因多样而精彩。不同文明相处，居高临下不可取，唯我独尊不可行，相互尊重、和衷共济、和合共生才是正确之路。要立足联合国平台加强国际人文交流，以庆祝“文明对话国际日”为契机，促进各国人民相知相亲，推动多元文明共同进步。要摒弃意识形态偏见，尊重各国人民自主选择的发展道路和社会制度，深化治国理政经验交流，共同探索破解时代难题。
units.en: Third, we should advance exchanges and mutual learning among civilizations and rebuild unity and mutual trust through communication and dialogue. Diversity has created splendor in the world. Condescension and a self-centered mindset have no place in the interactions among different cultures. Promoting mutual respect, solidarity and harmonious coexistence is the right approach to take. We need to use the U.N. platform to boost international people-to-people exchanges, and take the celebration of the International Day for Dialogue Among Civilizations as an occasion to promote mutual understanding and amity among all peoples and the common development of diverse civilizations. We should reject ideological prejudice, and respect the development paths and social systems decided on independently by the people of all countries. We should deepen the sharing of governance practices and jointly explore ways to tackle challenges facing our times.

units.zh: 第四，高举多边主义旗帜，以实际行动捍卫公平正义。多边主义是人类历经劫难后的共同选择，公平正义是各国人民的共同追求。中方主张，国家不分大小，都是国际社会平等一员；世界上的事，要由大家商量着办，共同维护国际法治和公平正义。各国应当团结起来、行动起来，维护联合国、壮大联合国。中方支持联合国改革完善，推进“联合国80周年改革倡议”，不只简单做预算与授权的减法，更要做好机构效能的加法，有效应对气候变化、公共卫生安全等全球性挑战，完善网络、外空、极地等领域治理规则，真正扩大全球南方代表性和发言权。
units.en: Fourth, we should stay committed to multilateralism and take steps to safeguard fairness and justice. Multilateralism is the choice made by humanity after going through scourges, and fairness and justice are the joint pursuit of the people of all countries. China holds that all countries, big or small, are equal members of the international community, and that world affairs should be handled by all through consultation, and rule of law, fairness and justice in international affairs should be jointly upheld. Countries should join forces and act together to safeguard the U.N. and make it stronger. China supports the U.N. in reforming and improving itself. It should advance the U.N. 80 Initiative and enhance the performance of its bodies rather than merely cut its budgets and mandates. It should effectively address global challenges including climate change and public health security, improve governance rules in such areas as cyberspace, outer space and polar regions, and truly increase the representation and voice of the Global South.

units.zh: 中方向任职即将届满的古特雷斯秘书长致以崇高敬意。中方支持根据联合国宪章规定，选出一位恪守宪章、能力出众、公道正派、履职担当的新任秘书长。
units.en: China pays high tribute to Secretary General António Guterres who will complete his term soon. China supports the election, in accordance with the U.N. Charter, of a new secretary general who honors the U.N. Charter, has exceptional capability, upholds integrity and fairness, and demonstrates courage and dedication.

units.zh: 主席先生，各位同事，
units.en: Mr. President, Colleagues,

units.zh: 1971年10月25日，正是在这个庄严的大厅，第26届联大以压倒性多数通过第2758号决议，决定恢复中华人民共和国在联合国的一切权利，承认中华人民共和国政府代表是中国在联合国的唯一合法代表，这对中国、对世界都具有重大而深远的意义。
units.en: On October 25, 1971, right here in this august hall, the General Assembly adopted Resolution 2758 at its 26th Session with an overwhelming majority, by which the UNGA decided to restore all the rights of the People’s Republic of China in the U.N. and recognize the representatives of the Government of the People’s Republic of China as the only legitimate representatives of China to the U.N. This is of profound and far-reaching significance for both China and the world.

units.zh: 55年来，中国始终是动荡世界的稳定力量，坚定不移走和平发展道路，是和平和安全记录最好的大国。中国是联合国安理会常任理事国中第一大维和出兵国，成功推动五核国领导人首次就防止核战争发表联合声明。中国始终是共同发展的中坚力量，创造了经济快速发展和社会长期稳定两大奇迹，对世界经济增长的贡献率长期保持在30%左右。中国携手全球超过四分之三的国家高质量共建“一带一路”；在全球发展倡议框架下动员230多亿美元资金，开展2000多个合作项目；实施对非洲和最不发达建交国零关税政策，赋能全球南方现代化进程。中国始终是变革时代的进步力量，坚持为全球南方仗义执言，维护发展中国家正当权益，持续推动全球治理体系朝着更加公正合理的方向发展。今年10月，全球治理论坛将在雄安新区举办，欢迎大家共赴未来之约，共商治理大计。
units.en: Over the past 55 years, China has been a stabilizing force in times of volatility. China is firmly committed to pursuing peaceful development, and has the best track record on peace and security among major countries. It is the largest contributor of peacekeepers among the permanent members of the U.N. Security Council. It also took the initiative that led to the issuance of the first joint statement of the leaders of the five nuclear-weapon states on preventing nuclear war. China has been a main engine driving common development. China has created two miracles at home, namely, fast economic growth and long-term social stability, and it has, over many years, contributed around 30 percent to global growth. China has joined hands with more than three fourths of the countries in the world in pursuing high-quality Belt and Road cooperation, it has mobilized over US$23 billion and carried out more than 2,000 projects under the Global Development Initiative, and it has granted zero-tariff status to all the African countries and least developed countries having diplomatic relations with it to empower the Global South in pursuing modernization. China has been a progressive force in an era of change. China has always spoken up for the Global South, stood up for the legitimate rights and interests of developing countries, and continued to work toward a more just and equitable global governance system. In October, China will host the Global Governance Forum in the Xiong’an New Area. You are welcome to attend the forum and join in the discussion about the way forward in global governance.

units.zh: 主席先生，各位同事，
units.en: Mr. President, Colleagues,

units.zh: 无论国际形势如何变化，中国对和平与发展的追求矢志不渝，对公平正义的守护坚定不移，对多边主义的承诺始终如一。中国愿同各国携手同行，在推动构建人类命运共同体的伟大实践中，共创人类更加美好的未来！谢谢大家。
units.en: No matter how the international dynamics evolve, China remains unchanged in its pursuit of peace and development, in its dedication to safeguarding fairness and justice, and in its commitment to multilateralism. China will join hands with all other countries to build a community with a shared future for humanity and make the world a better place for all of us. Thank you.

files.name: 20260924习近平在白宫欢迎仪式上的致辞 中英对照

units.zh: 在白宫欢迎仪式上的致辞
units.en: Remarks by H.E. Xi Jinping President of the People’s Republic of China at Arrival Ceremony at the White House

units.zh: （2026年9月24日，华盛顿） 中华人民共和国主席 习近平 尊敬的特朗普总统和梅拉尼娅女士， 女士们，先生们，朋友们：
units.en: Honorable President Donald J. Trump and Mrs. Melania Trump, Ladies and Gentlemen, Dear Friends,

units.zh: 很高兴对美丽的美利坚合众国进行国事访问，感谢特朗普总统和夫人给予我和我夫人的热情款待。首先，我谨代表14亿多中国人民，向美国人民致以诚挚问候，向美国独立250周年表示热烈祝贺！
units.en: I’m very glad to pay a state visit to your beautiful country, the United States of America. Thank you, President Trump and Mrs. Trump, for the warm hospitality you have extended to me and my wife. On behalf of the 1.4 billion and more Chinese people, I wish to begin by extending sincere greetings to the American people and warm congratulations on the 250th anniversary of the American independence.

units.zh: 中国和美国都是伟大的国家，中国人民和美国人民都是伟大的人民。我这次应特朗普总统邀请访美，是为传承友谊而来，为拓展合作而来，为增进两国人民福祉而来。
units.en: Both China and the United States are great countries, and both the Chinese and American peoples are great peoples. I am visiting the United States at President Trump’s invitation to carry on our friendship, expand cooperation, and promote the well-being of both our peoples.

units.zh: 面对当今世界之变、时代之变、历史之变，中美两个大国肩负着促进人类发展进步的历史重任。
units.en: Facing the changes in our world, in our times, and of historical significance today, China and the United States, as two major countries, shoulder a historic responsibility of advancing human development and progress.

units.zh: 特朗普总统今年访华期间，我们一致同意构建中美建设性战略稳定关系，受到两国人民和国际社会广泛欢迎。我愿同特朗普总统一道努力，引领中美关系这艘大船行稳致远。
units.en: Mr. President, during your visit to China this year, we agreed to build a constructive China-U.S. relationship of strategic stability, and this is widely welcomed by the people of our two countries and the international community. I am ready to work with you to steer the giant ship of China-U.S. relationship on a steady course toward the future.

units.zh: ——我们要加强沟通。中美两国国情不同，通过坦诚、深入、持续的对话能够增进理解、求同存异、积累互信。我和特朗普总统彼此尊重，已建立良好关系，保持经常性沟通。我们鼓励两国外交、经贸、财金、执法、人文等各部门加强沟通，支持两国立法机构扩大交流。
units.en: —We should strengthen communication. China and the United States are different in national conditions, but through candid, in-depth and continued dialogue, our two countries can understand each other better, seek common ground while shelving differences, and build up mutual trust. President Trump and I have respect for each other. We have built personal rapport and stayed in touch. We encourage our government departments, such as those in charge of foreign affairs, economic matters, financial cooperation, law enforcement and people-to-people exchanges, to catch up on strengthening contact, and we support our legislative bodies in increasing exchanges.

units.zh: ——我们要真诚合作。中美两国利益深度交融，合作空间十分广阔。虽然中美合作不可能解决世界上所有问题，但没有两国合作，世界上很多问题都难以解决。中国开放的大门始终敞开，欢迎美国企业来华投资兴业，希望美方公平对待中国企业，共同拉长合作清单，压缩问题清单。中美两国都是人工智能大国，有能力也有责任发展好、管控好人工智能，确保人工智能发展始终受控于人、造福于民。中方愿同美国加强禁毒、执法等合作。双方可以增加直航航班，让双方人员和经贸往来更加便捷。
units.en: —We should cooperate with sincerity. The interests of China and the United States are deeply intertwined, and there is plenty of room for us to work together. China-U.S. cooperation may not solve every problem in the world. But, without our cooperation, it would be hard to solve many of the world’s problems. China keeps its door wide open, welcomes American companies wanting to invest and do business there. We hope Chinese companies are treated fairly here in the United States. Working together, we can lengthen the list of cooperation, and shorten the list of issues. Both China and the United States are leading nations in artificial intelligence. We have both the capability and responsibility to develop and manage AI for good, and ensure that the development of AI is always under human control and serves the well-being of the people. On counternarcotics and law enforcement, the Chinese side is willing to strengthen cooperation with the United States. Our two sides may also increase direct flights to facilitate two-way travel and trade.

units.zh: ——我们要和平共处。我多次讲，中美两个大国合则两利、斗则俱伤。中美不必讳言竞争，但竞争应该是良性的、有边界的，应该是你追我赶的赛跑，而不是你输我赢的角斗。中美双方必须守住不冲突、不对抗的底线，也一定能走出一条两个大国在这个星球上的正确相处之道。两国军队要保持常态化对话，完善危机沟通和预防机制。“修昔底德陷阱”是可以跨越的。
units.en: —We should coexist in peace. As I have said many times, China and the United States, as two major countries, stand to gain from cooperation and will both lose in confrontation. We do not need to avoid mentioning competition, but our competition should be a healthy one and should be kept within bounds. It should be a race of catching up with one another, not a wrestle in which one either wins or loses. China and the United States must hold the line of no conflict and no confrontation between us, and we can certainly find the right path for our two great countries to get along on this planet we both call home. Our two militaries should maintain regular dialogue, and improve mechanisms for crisis communication and prevention. The Thucydides Trap can be overcome.

units.zh: 女士们、先生们、朋友们！
units.en: Ladies and Gentlemen, Dear Friends,

units.zh: 第二次世界大战期间，中美并肩抗击法西斯侵略。对于这段历史，中国人民不会忘记，美国人民也没有忘记。中美关系希望在人民、未来在青年。这里，我愿宣布，未来5年，中方将邀请10万名美国青少年来华交流学习。
units.en: During the Second World War, Chinese and Americans fought shoulder to shoulder against fascist aggression. Chinese people have never forgotten that part of history, nor have the American people. The hope of the China-U.S. relationship lies in our people, and its future lies with the young. I am glad to announce an invitation for 100,000 young Americans to visit China for exchanges and study in the coming five years.

units.zh: 大熊猫是中美两国人民友谊的使者。今天，我要分享一个好消息，再过几天，大熊猫“平平”、“福双”就会落户亚特兰大动物园，同美国人民见面。
units.en: The giant panda has been an envoy of friendship between the Chinese and Americans. Here, I have a piece of good news. In a few days, two pandas, Ping Ping and Fu Shuang, will come to their new home in Zoo Atlanta and meet with the American people.

units.zh: 女士们、先生们、朋友们！
units.en: Ladies and Gentlemen, Dear Friends,

units.zh: 实现中华民族伟大复兴和让美国再次伟大并行不悖。让我们秉持人民情怀、展现历史主动，不断推进中美两国人民友好事业，携手共建一个更加美好的世界！
units.en: Achieving the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation and making America great again can go hand in hand. Let us meet the people’s expectation and show our historical initiative. Let us keep advancing the cause of friendship between our two peoples and work together to build a better world!

units.zh: 谢谢大家！
units.en: Thank you.

files.name: 20260925韩正在全球发展倡议5周年高级别对话会上的致辞 中英对照

units.zh: 韩正在全球发展倡议5周年高级别对话会上的致辞（全文）
units.en: Remarks by H.E. Han Zheng Vice President of the People’s Republic of China At the High-Level Dialogue on the Fifth Anniversary of the Global Development Initiative

units.zh: 汇聚发展合力 共创美好未来
units.en: Pooling Strengths for Development and Creating a Better Future Together
New York, September 25, 2026

units.zh: 中华人民共和国副主席 韩正 尊敬的各位嘉宾， 女士们，先生们，朋友们：
units.en: Distinguished Guests, Ladies and Gentlemen, Dear Friends,

units.zh: 欢迎大家出席全球发展倡议5周年高级别对话会。2021年9月，习近平主席在第76届联合国大会上提出全球发展倡议。5年来，在习近平主席亲自推动和各方共同努力下，全球发展倡议从中方理念主张转化为国际共同行动，将发展规划蓝图绘就成现实合作图景，为落实联合国2030年可持续发展议程贡献了中国方案和中国力量。
units.en: Welcome to the High-Level Dialogue on the Fifth Anniversary of the Global Development Initiative (GDI). In September 2021, President Xi Jinping put forward the GDI at the 76th Session of the United Nations General Assembly. Five years on, thanks to his personal commitment and the concerted efforts of all parties, the GDI has been translated from a Chinese vision and proposal into collective global action, and from a development blueprint into concrete cooperation projects on the ground. Through the Initiative, China has contributed its wisdom and resources to implementing the U.N.’s 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development.

units.zh: ——全球发展倡议强化了发展优先的国际共识。我们召开全球发展高层对话会，创办全球共享发展行动论坛，连续4年在联合国总部举办全球发展倡议高级别会议，推动将发展置于国际议程中心位置。
units.en: —The GDI helps build a stronger international consensus on putting development first. We have convened a High-Level Dialogue on Global Development, launched a Forum on Global Action for Shared Development, and held high-level meetings on the GDI at the U.N. Headquarters for four consecutive years. These events have helped make development a central priority on the international agenda.
